levels.surface: تميم بن عبد الله بن تميم القرشي

notes: «حدثنا أبي» : the father of Tamim is not named, so he stands as a relation (rule 7)
Harthama speaks in the first person after the chain: his own report is the last link
inside the narrated encounter the Imam al-Rida speaks and acts; he is read as part of the scene, not as a source, and the ruling is needed (rule 11)
the blessings after names are not part of the surfaces
